questions.q:
From the given alternatives, choose the correct meaning of the idiom.

What goes around comes around.
options: People's actions have consequences that will eventually return to them
People's pets will eventually return home if they go out
If you throw a stone up, it will fall down
A drunkard will eventually return home
questions.solution:
The idiom means that a person's actions, good or bad, eventually come back to them in the same form - actions have consequences that return to the doer.
**Answer: People's actions have consequences that will eventually return to them**

questions.q:
From the alternatives given below, select the correct meaning of the idiom.

Cast the first stone.
options: To be the first to criticize someone or something
To be the first to give a comment on an Instagram post
To be the first to invent something
To be the first to invite someone
questions.solution:
'Cast the first stone' (a Biblical expression) means to be the first to attack or criticise someone, usually when the critic is not blameless either.
**Answer: To be the first to criticize someone or something**

questions.q:
Select the option with the correct spelling that can replace the underlined word in the given sentence. If the spelling in the given sentence is already correct, choose Option “No replacement required”.

The film's __gratuitous__ violence was criticised for being unnecessary and excessive.
questions.solution:
'Gratuitous' (meaning unnecessary and uncalled-for) is the correct spelling in the sentence, so no replacement is needed.
**Answer: No replacement required**

questions.q:
Select the option with the correct spelling that can replace the underlined word in the given sentence. If the spelling in the given sentence is already correct, choose Option "No replacement required".

His comments were not __garmane__ to the topic at hand and distracted from the main issue.
questions.solution:
The correct spelling is 'germane', which means relevant and closely connected to the matter being discussed. 'Garmane' is wrongly spelt.
**Answer: germane**

questions.q: Choose the word that is the closest synonym to the word "aroma".
questions.solution:
'Aroma' means a pleasant, distinctive smell, so its closest synonym is 'fragrance'.
**Answer: Fragrance**

questions.q: Choose the word that is the most appropriate synonym of the word "brisk".
questions.solution:
'Brisk' means quick, energetic and active in manner.
**Answer: Quick**

questions.q: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "active".
questions.solution:
'Active' means energetic and engaged; its opposite is 'passive', meaning inactive or not taking part.
**Answer: Passive**

questions.q: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "borrow".
questions.solution:
'Borrow' means to take something temporarily from someone; its opposite is 'lend', to give something temporarily.
**Answer: Lend**

questions.q:
Choose the most suitable one-word substitution for the following.

A government ruled by nobles.
questions.solution:
Government by nobles (the aristocratic class) is called 'aristocracy'. Oligarchy is rule by a few powerful people and autocracy is rule by one person with absolute power.
**Answer: Aristocracy**

questions.q:
Choose the most suitable one-word substitution for the following.

A government ruled by a king or queen.
questions.solution:
Government by a king or a queen is called 'monarchy'.
**Answer: Monarchy**

questions.q:
Select the correct alternative to fill in the blank with the correct preposition in the following sentence.

Robin is the only heir ________ his father's property.
questions.solution:
'Heir' takes the preposition 'to' - one is the 'heir to' a property, a title or a throne.
**Answer: to**

questions.q:
Select the correct alternative to fill in the blank with the correct preposition in the following sentence.

Robin Hood was popular ________ poor people.
questions.solution:
'Popular among' is the correct collocation when we talk of being liked by a group of people.
**Answer: among**

questions.q:
In the given question, a sentence is divided into four parts and given in the alternatives (A), (B), (C), and (D). There is an error in one part. Choose the alternative containing that part of the sentence that has the error. Choosing the alternative with the error will be the answer.

It was very stupid about the boy to have spent five thousand rupees on that dictionary.
questions.solution:
Adjectives describing personal qualities (stupid, kind, wise, foolish) take 'of + person', not 'about + person'.
The correct sentence is 'It was very stupid of the boy to have spent...'. So the error lies in the second part.
**Answer: stupid about the boy to**

questions.q:
In the given question, a sentence is divided into four parts and given in the alternatives (A), (B), (C), and (D). There is an error in one part. Choose the alternative containing that part of the sentence that has the error. Choosing the alternative with the error will be the answer.

The Golden Temple was crowded by millions of devotees from all around the world on the day of Baisakhi.
questions.solution:
A place is 'crowded with' people, not 'crowded by' people; 'by' would wrongly suggest an agent performing the action.
So the error lies in the second part.
**Answer: crowded by millions of devotees**

questions.q:
Select the correct alternative to fill in the blank with the correct preposition in the following sentence.

The young man resorted to frequent outings in pursuit _______ happiness.
questions.solution:
'Pursuit' is always followed by 'of' - the fixed phrase is 'in pursuit of happiness'.
**Answer: of**

questions.q:
Select the correct alternative to fill in the blank with the correct preposition in the following sentence.

The tourists fell victims ________ some antisocial factors.
questions.solution:
'Fall victim to' is a fixed phrase, so 'fell victims to some antisocial elements' is correct.
**Answer: to**

questions.q:
A part of the following sentence is underlined. Choose the option which can replace the underlined part to improve the sentence. In case Options A, B and C are not found suitable, choose Option D: “No Improvement Required.”

The economic reforms introduced last year are __aimed at bringing up__ the overall productivity of the nation.
questions.solution:
'Bring about' means to cause to happen, which suits productivity; 'bring up' means to rear children or raise a topic.
The preposition 'at' after 'aimed' is correct, so only 'up' needs to change to 'about'.
**Answer: aimed at bringing about**

questions.q:
A part of the following sentence is underlined. Choose the option which can replace the underlined part to improve the sentence. In case Options A, B and C are not found suitable, choose Option D: “No Improvement Required.”

The members of the club have been waiting eagerly __for the chief guest to arrive since two hours__.
options: to the chief guest's arrival since two hours
for the chief guest to arrive for two hours
for the chief guest's arrival from two hours
questions.solution:
'Since' is used for a point of time, while a duration like 'two hours' takes 'for'.
Hence 'for the chief guest to arrive for two hours' is correct.
**Answer: for the chief guest to arrive for two hours**

questions.q:
A part of the following sentence is underlined. Choose the option that can replace the underlined part to improve the sentence. If you feel Options A, B, or C do not improve the sentence, then choose Option D: "No improvement required."

Regular exercise __will have the effect of increasing your energy levels__ and help you feel more refreshed throughout the day.
options: will have the affect of increasing your energy levels
will affect the increase of your energy levels
questions.solution:
The wordy phrase 'will have the effect of increasing' is best replaced by the direct and concise 'will increase'.
**Answer: will increase your energy levels**

questions.q:
A part of the following sentence is underlined. Choose the option that can replace the underlined part to improve the sentence. If you feel Options A, B, or C do not improve the sentence, then choose Option D: “No improvement required.”

It was __a once-in-the-lifetime opportunity__ that many would consider invaluable, but very few got the chance to experience.
questions.solution:
The correct idiom is 'once-in-a-lifetime', and the article 'a' is right because 'once' begins with a consonant sound (/w/).
**Answer: a once-in-a-lifetime**

questions.q: Why is Mary Wollstonecraft regarded as a foundational figure in feminist theory?
options: She wrote extensively about women's rights and directly challenged the notion that women were naturally weak and inferior
She focused only on her own experiences, without addressing the larger social issues affecting women and their treatment as mere property
She argued that women should stay within domestic roles and avoid intellectual pursuits
She believed women did not need education and supported traditional gender expectations
questions.solution:
Mary Wollstonecraft, author of 'A Vindication of the Rights of Woman' (1792), is regarded as a founder of feminist thought because she wrote extensively for women's rights and rejected the claim that women are naturally weak or inferior.
**Answer: She wrote extensively about women's rights and directly challenged the notion that women were naturally weak and inferior**

questions.q: What central argument does Wollstonecraft make in A Vindication of the Rights of Woman?
options: Women ought to recognize their inferior position as a natural obligation and therefore should not dispute the current social order.
Women's education is a necessity for their active and equal participation in society, thus overthrowing the male-dominated social structure.
Women are by nature fit for the house and should not engage in the intellect, as the quest for knowledge would disturb the social order.
The advancement of society is dependent on the confinement of women to domestic roles and the maintenance of the male-dominated structure.
questions.solution:
In 'A Vindication of the Rights of Woman' her central argument is that women are not naturally inferior; education is a necessity so that they can take part actively and equally in society instead of staying confined to domestic roles.
**Answer: Women's education is a necessity for their active and equal participation in society, thus overthrowing the male-dominated social structure**

questions.q: Why did Wollstonecraft face public criticism after her death?
options: Her writings were viewed as too radical and were seen as a challenge to established religious beliefs.
She openly rejected motherhood and family life in her published works.
Details of her personal life, including her love affairs, became public.
She advocated Marxist-feminist ideas, which were not widely accepted during her era.
questions.solution:
After her death, the memoir written by her husband William Godwin made details of her private life - including her love affairs - public, which scandalised society and brought her criticism.
**Answer: Details of her personal life, including her love affairs, became public**

questions.q: In what ways did Wollstonecraft’s feminist approach stand in contrast to that of Marxist-feminist thinkers?
options: She limited her examination to economic equality, neglecting the cultural and social side of gender discrimination
She maintained that class struggle was a more important factor than gender equity in the pursuit of social justice
She regarded patriarchy as an illusion and considered women to be instinctively suited for the home
She highlighted the importance of motherhood in society's development, which wasn’t considered by Marxist feminists
questions.solution:
Options A and B actually describe the Marxist-feminist stress on economics and class struggle, and option C contradicts Wollstonecraft's views completely.
That leaves the contrast the passage draws: she valued the role of motherhood in society's development, something the class-focused Marxist feminists did not highlight.
**Answer: She highlighted the importance of motherhood in society's development, which wasn't considered by Marxist feminists**

questions.q: Which idea best reflects Wollstonecraft’s critique of patriarchy?
options: Women's subordination is seen as a moral duty, but through education, they can be made to understand and contest their position.
Women are naturally inferior and should be limited to domestic responsibilities, which include taking care of their family
Gender inequality is so entrenched that it cannot be addressed through social reform; that's why people should accept the patriarchal setup without any protest
Intellectual pursuits for women only result in family discord, which is why they should not break free from their pre-defined roles
questions.solution:
Wollstonecraft's critique of patriarchy was that women's subordination was accepted as a natural or moral duty, but with proper education women would recognise and challenge that position.
**Answer: Women's subordination is seen as a moral duty, but through education, they can be made to understand and contest their position**
